set.body:
Single root for the 1.0 release. Established 2026-10-09 by a tracker sweep; proposed scope awaits owner confirmation in the w0 scope decision.

Definition of 1.0 (two deliverables, one release):
- Library 1.0: PRD acceptance A-1..A-27, foundation acceptance M6, artifacts on Maven Central (JVM + Scala.js), MiMa policy.
- Eyes Studio 1.0: studio gates G1-G5 on the real eyes4s backend (point B of docs/studio/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md).

Order of approach (tag v1-wN; each wave is a child epic of this bead):
- w0 Stabilize and decide: hosted CI green, land in-flight reviews, owner decisions, request external data.
- w1 Real-backend golden slice (G1).
- w2 Qualified analysis workflow (G3) and real-study admission (G2).
- w3 Durable daily use (G4) and project lifecycle.
- w4 Library 1.0 release track (runs in parallel from w1; must finish before w5 closes).
- w5 Studio qualification and release (G5).

Everything else is tagged post-v1 (grouped under the post-1.0 backlog epic) or umbrella.
Progress: `mote children <this id>`, `mote ls --tag v1 --all`, `mote ls --tag v1-w1 --all`.
Rule: new work enters 1.0 only by tagging it v1 plus a wave and linking it to that wave epic; otherwise it is post-v1.
set.title: eyes4s 1.0: library 1.0 on Maven Central and Eyes Studio 1.0 (gate G5)
